credits.title: Tame
credits.overview: In a remote village where bulls are trained through fear and tradition, a young girl held captive by her family seeks the power of an ancient spirit for liberation, employing the same cruel techniques used to control her.

credits.title: Henry's First Dates
credits.overview: Lucy, a woman who's living her first date on repeat with Henry, a good-natured, animal-loving guy with a bizarre condition: every time he wakes up, he can't remember anything from the day before.

credits.title: Solids by the Seashore
credits.overview: In a corrupted southern Thai town struggling with its major environmental damage, a young Muslim woman is facing an inner struggle against the imposing wall of her cultural and religious background, as she develops a relationship with a female artist from out of town.

credits.title: Not Friends
credits.overview: A group of high school students who dream of making films set out to make a short film based on the life of a classmate. However, they discover a secret that could change their vision of filmmaking forever.

credits.title: Voices of the New Gen
credits.overview: Four emerging filmmakers present a collection of gritty short crime dramas and thrillers that reflect Thailand's social issues and politics.

credits.title: Bangkok Tradition
credits.overview: Dararat, a documentary typewriter in a daily newspaper company in Bangkok. She recently knew that she was about to get fired with no reason. credits.title: Anatomy of Time
credits.overview: A spiritual time-shifting drama following a woman from her carefree 20s in 1960s rural Thailand to present-day Bangkok as an older army general's wife.
